_comment: What the market shipped, measured rather than repeated. Every row is a
product we looked at ourselves; `measured` is the day we looked, and it is
printed on the page beside the number, because a version without a date is
a claim that ages into a lie.
This file is edited by a person, on purpose. Our own version is read from
the repository by build.py and can never drift; a competitor's cannot be
fetched without installing their product, so pretending the page polls
them live would be the one dishonest thing on it.
Source: docs/08-competitors.md, the market review of 12.09.2026.
